name: vitest-workerd-harness
title: Vitest in workerd with migrations applied, plus a production-history replay test
description: vitest.config.ts with cloudflareTest and readD1Migrations exposing TEST_MIGRATIONS, a setupFile that applies ./migrations to the test D1 before every test file, a harness self-check, and an optional replay test that applies newer migrations on top of the production state with rows in it.
author: Coop <coop@xavalabs.com>

params.name: prodSim
params.description: Add the production-history replay test: a second D1 (PROD_SIM_DB) in vitest.config.ts, test/migration-upgrade.test.ts and test/prod-seed.ts. Off keeps vitest.config.ts byte-identical to the hono-d1 template.

params.name: shippedThrough
params.description: Only with prodSim: the highest migration number production has already run; the replay applies 1..N, seeds rows, then applies the rest.

bindings.name: DB
bindings.note: Tests read the D1 binding named DB from wrangler.jsonc; Miniflare backs it locally.

agent.summary: Runs every test in workerd with the project's migrations applied to a local D1. Default install is a no-op on the hono-d1 template (identical files are skipped). With prodSim it adds a replay test that applies newer migrations over the production state.
when_to_use: A Worker project has no vitest-in-workerd setup yet.
You want proof that new migrations keep production rows intact.
when_not_to_use: The project already has a different vitest.config.ts you want to keep: the install stops with a file conflict.
The project tests with Node-only mocks of D1.

adapt.title: Install the test dependencies
adapt.do: Run the package manager install so @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers and vitest are present.

adapt.title: Seed real production-shaped rows (prodSim only)
adapt.do: Add one INSERT per row for tables that hold data you cannot lose, written against the schema as of shippedThrough.
adapt.check: test/migration-upgrade.test.ts passes and fails when a migration drops a seeded column value.

agent.author_notes: A migration that is already live must never be edited; the replay test is what catches a new one that breaks existing rows.
